changelog:
Initial release of text2qa skill.

- Extracts structured Q&A pairs and selection preferences from chat sessions or any text source.
- Automatically identifies both explicit and implicit questions and answers.
- Synthesizes related dialog into standalone, clearly formatted Q&A pairs.
- Detects and lists user preferences, constraints, and decision criteria, marking each as direct or inferred.
- Outputs results in two sections: Q&A Pairs and Selection Preferences, with counts for each.
- Designed to support summarizing sessions, creating quizzes/flashcards, and building reusable knowledge bases.
